name: 230 Fifth Rooftop
status_note: Official site current in Oct 2026 with upcoming events and Igloo Bar (Nov–Apr) info.

dress.answer: Casual, no sweats or gym clothes
dress.detail: Official info page says to wear what you love but no sweatpants or gym clothes; a third-party listing reports a stricter weekend code (no athletic wear, hoodies, ripped or baggy jeans).

age.value: 21+ Fri–Sat after 7pm; under-21s allowed with their own parent at other times; government ID required

cover.value: $15 Fri / $20 Sat from 8pm; $30 skip-the-line tickets on Eventbrite; no cover other nights

getting_in.value: Walk-ins welcome at all times; reservations only for parties of 10+ (up to 30 days ahead); weekend lines after 8pm

hours.value: Mon–Thu noon–1:30am (last order); Fri noon–late (last entry 2am); Sat 11am–4am (last entry 2:30am); Sun 11am–1:30am (last order). Official site also shows a conflicting set; confirm late hours.

accessibility.value: Listed as wheelchair accessible by NYC Tourism; elevator details not published

subway.value: 28 St (R, W) at Broadway, ~2 min walk; also 28 St (6) at Park Ave, ~5 min

skip_if: You hate crowds: reviewers say the rooftop gets packed on summer evenings and Fri–Sat primetime.
You want a quiet drink late on weekends: after 8pm it shifts to a cover-charge, line-at-the-door party scene.
